Write the whole-module specification

Read input: rtlpp_00791_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_00791(
    input wire clk,
    input wire reset,
    input wire [1:0] select,
    input wire [3:0] in0,
    input wire [3:0] in1,
    input wire [3:0] in2,
    input wire [3:0] in3,
    input wire in0_valid,
    input wire in1_valid,
    input wire in2_valid,
    input wire in3_valid,
    output reg [3:0] out_b,
    output reg out_valid_b
);

    reg [3:0] out_1_mux, out_2_mux;
    reg valid_1_mux, valid_2_mux;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            out_1_mux <= 4'b0;
            valid_1_mux <= 0;
            out_2_mux <= 4'b0;
            valid_2_mux <= 0;
            out_b <= 4'b0;
            out_valid_b <= 0;
        end else begin
            case (select[0])
                1'b0: begin
                    out_1_mux <= in0;
                    valid_1_mux <= in0_valid;
                end
                1'b1: begin
                    out_1_mux <= in1;
                    valid_1_mux <= in1_valid;
                end
            endcase

            case (select[0])
                1'b0: begin
                    out_2_mux <= in2;
                    valid_2_mux <= in2_valid;
                end
                1'b1: begin
                    out_2_mux <= in3;
                    valid_2_mux <= in3_valid;
                end
            endcase

            case (select[1])
                1'b0: begin
                    out_b <= out_1_mux;
                    out_valid_b <= valid_1_mux;
                end
                1'b1: begin
                    out_b <= out_2_mux;
                    out_valid_b <= valid_2_mux;
                end
            endcase
        end
    end
    
endmodule
